The declaration does not assume how many window records exist; the run reports it.

population.unit: one Horse betting decision (a decision journal record) whose request snapshot stage is preflop, joined to its request lifecycle, execution witness and completed hand
population.street: preflop only; Phase 6 is the tournament preflop atlas and postflop decisions never consult it. Postflop decisions are counted as rejected:postflop and fill no cell.
population.cells: the product of the axes with one exclusion: format cash admits branch none only, because the atlas coordinate exists only in tournament mode. 81 cash cells plus 4 x 12 x 9 x 3 x 3 = 3888 tournament cells; 3969 declared cells in total

classification.format: snapshot.gameState.format, else 'mtt' when gameMode is 'tournament' (or, without gameMode, when a tournament object is present or bigBlind >= 10), else 'cash'; this mirrors HorseLogic
classification.branch: phase6Attribution.lookup.coordinate.branch when a lookup was recorded, else 'none'
classification.size: phase6Attribution.lookup.coordinate.tableSize when a lookup was recorded, else tournament.playersAtTable, else max(2, snapshot.gameState.players.length)
classification.anteMode: phase6Attribution.lookup.coordinate.anteType when a lookup was recorded, else tournament.anteType, else big_blind when bigBlindAnte is true, else per_player when ante > 0, else none
classification.path: fallback when decision.policyFallback is set, the execution witness policyFallback is set, or the bound accepted action carries origin horse_fallback; otherwise bypass when phase6Attribution.status is 'bypassed'; otherwise normal when status is 'atlas_evaluated' or when status is 'unavailable' with reason 'outside_tournament' (cash never consults the atlas); otherwise fallback when status is 'unavailable' with any other reason (incomplete_context, unsupported_variant, invalid_coordinate, m_unavailable, lookup_unavailable, tournament_schema_unavailable); a preflop decision without a phase6Attribution is rejected:unclassified_path and fills no cell
classification.outsideDeclaration: any decision whose classified cell is not one of the declared cells is counted as rejected:undeclared_cell and never fills a cell

selection.order: ascending archive_events rowid inside the window, in hourly strata
selection.strata: one stratum per started hour from window.startMs (stratum h starts at window.startMs + h * 3600000 and ends one hour later or at window.endMs, whichever is first); its first rowid is found by binary search on record atMs over the existing archive_events rowids from min(rowid) to max(rowid) (each probe decodes exactly one segment); a stratum with no archived record is reported as 'stratum empty: no archived records'
selection.handRule: the first 400 distinct hand_keys at or after the stratum's first rowid, in rowid order; each hand is read once with HorseDecisionJournalStore.readHand and every preflop decision record in it is classified; a hand whose custody is still pending is counted as pendingCustody and skipped
selection.fillRule: a classified decision is admitted to its cell only while that cell's observed count is below targetPerCell; decisions beyond the target are counted per cell as overflow and are not listed; nothing is drawn from outside the strata, no cell is filled from a neighbouring cell, and no unobserved cell is inferred from any other
selection.stop: after all strata are walked; the run also stops early and says so if the observer's 600 second deadline is reached (stopReason=deadline)

chain.request: present when a request_lifecycle record with phase 'requested' exists for the decision's producer and turnKey and its requestDigest equals horseLifecycleRequestDigest of the decision snapshot; otherwise missing:request_lifecycle or missing:request_digest
chain.calculation: present when the decision record carries a valid decision receipt for the snapshot's variant, valid rngBefore/rngAfter sampling state and valid compute metadata; otherwise missing:calculation_receipt
chain.reference: present when the decision carries a phase6Attribution that validates and matches the snapshot (horsePhase6AttributionMatchesSnapshot); otherwise missing:reference
chain.acceptedAction: present when an execution witness exists for the same producer and turnKey with executionStatus intended or coerced and exactly one accepted action that is intended; retired decisions (not_executed with a retirement reason) report missing:accepted_action:<retirementReason>; a witness with no accepted action reports missing:accepted_action; no witness reports missing:execution_witness
chain.completedHand: present when the hand has an accepted_hand record whose completed-hand key equals the hand key and bindHorseDecisionToCommittedHand binds the witness to an action ordinal of that hand; otherwise missing:accepted_hand or missing:hand_binding:<reason>
chain.review: reconcileHorseJournalHand from the serving image runs on every read hand; its status and gaps are copied beside the chain and never replace the per-link marks
chain.complete: a chain is complete only when all five links are present

prohibitions: no record is written anywhere on the engine host
no cell is filled, averaged, extrapolated or expressed as a percentage
no decision outside the strata or outside the declared cells is admitted

the window, strata, hands per stratum, target, axes and admitted releases cannot change after this file is committed; the selector refuses a run whose declaration digest differs from the one recorded in the population output
